source.frozen_source_text: (iii) Within the Bow area of all Polar Class ships, and within the Bow Intermediate Icebelt area of Polar Class PC6 and PC7, the ice load parameters are functions of the actual bow shape. To determine the ice load parameters (Pavg, b and w), it is required to calculate the following ice load characteristics for sub-regions of the bow area; shape coefficient (fai), total glancing impact force (Fi), line load (Qi) and pressure (Pi).
source.source_applicability_review: The full source distinguishes Bow areas of all Polar Classes and Bow-Intermediate Icebelt areas for PC6/PC7; characteristics are calculated for bow sub-regions. This does not specify an RDF owner for totalGlancingImpactForce.
